title: Starve Acre
review: Imagine having to live in Yorkshire. It's a terrifying thought, but a reality some people have to endure every day. Downplaying the death was a great idea. The puppetry is exactly as good as it should have been, rather than distracting CGI or stop motion. The score is one of the film's best qualities: a mix of industrial driving beats with droning horns and warbling voices and strings. The two leads (Daemon and Maud) are good casting, and do the accents well enough. I think I still hear a little Welsh from Morfydd but Matt is excellent. This is like a much better version of {Lamb}.
